headline_marked: [[Over Tk 3 crore]] stolen in armed robbery; one injured in firing
headline: Over Tk 3 crore stolen in armed robbery; one injured in firing
summary: A group of around 10 motorcyclists allegedly intercepted a car carrying cash and opened fire, injuring an employee and making off with over Tk 3 crore. The incident occurred in Sreepur, Gazipur.
details: A brazen armed robbery occurred in Sreepur, Gazipur, where assailants on approximately 10 motorcycles allegedly opened fire on a private car carrying cash. The attackers reportedly stole over Tk 3 crore, injuring one of the car's occupants in the process. The incident took place around 6:30 PM on Friday.

The injured individual, identified as Md. Himel, 29, an accounting manager for a bKash agent institution named 'Bhaluka Channel Enterprise Sreepur Limited', sustained a gunshot wound to his abdomen. Another official, Md. Fahad, the institution's manager, was reportedly assaulted with a machete. The car's driver was also beaten during the incident.

According to witnesses, the assailants smashed the car's window with a machete and fired shots. They then seized two of the three money bags from the vehicle before fleeing. The entire operation is said to have lasted only one to two minutes.

The victims were reportedly transporting the cash from a distribution office in Narsingdi to their Mauna office in Sreepur. After collecting the money after Friday prayers, they began their journey around 4:30 PM. Their vehicle was intercepted in the Kornopur area of the Sreepur-Gosinga road.

Following the attack, the driver, despite being injured, drove the car to the Sreepur Upazila Health Complex. Himel, who was shot, received initial treatment there before being transferred to Shaheed Tajuddin Ahmad Medical College Hospital in Gazipur for further medical care. His condition is currently being monitored.

Police have confirmed that they received reports of the armed robbery and shooting. Law enforcement officials have visited the crime scene and are in the process of taking legal action. An investigation into the incident is underway.
